copy.tagline: 运行 ESM 模型进行蛋白质结构预测与推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质结构或运行 ESM 模型推理。
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and run ESM model inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict protein structures or run ESM model inference.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会编写 Python 代码调用 ESM 工具,帮你生成或补全蛋白序列、从序列预测结构、计算蛋白嵌入表示,并给出用法说明。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 ESM Python 工具、ESM3/ESMC 模型、Forge/Biohub 推理接口或 ESMFold2 流程时触发。

say.text: 用 ESM3 补全这段蛋白序列的空缺部分
用 ESM3 预测这条序列的蛋白结构
say.note: 返回 3D 坐标与 PDB 文本。

say.text: 用 ESMC 算这两条蛋白序列的嵌入向量
say.note: 返回每条序列的嵌入表示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes Python code using the ESM SDK to generate or complete protein sequences, predict structures from sequences, compute protein embeddings, and run related protein design tasks, with code examples and usage guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task works with the esm Python SDK, ESM3/ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows, such as when you ask to generate or analyze proteins with these tools.

say_en.text: Use ESM3 to complete the missing part of this protein sequence.
Use ESM3 to predict the structure for this sequence.
Use ESMC to compute embeddings for these two protein sequences.
